name: Alpha-Phase Tungsten
description: Alpha-phase tungsten (α-W) thin films deposited by sputtering and evaporation — used for refractory contacts and X-ray optics. Targets: 99.95 %, 2 in.
description_ko: 스퍼터링·증발 증착으로 형성하는 알파상 텅스텐(α-W) 박막입니다. 내열 컨택·X선 광학에 활용됩니다. 타깃: 순도 99.95 %, 2 인치.
filmSpecs: Film-coated by DC magnetron sputtering vacuum < 1.0 × 10⁻⁶ Torr
Applications : Low-Resistivity Interconnects, Semiconductor Contacts, Via and Contact Fill
